nodes.description: The flattened top-to-bottom sequence of mod nodes IS the file-conflict-resolution priority order (MO2-style), not merely cosmetic. Separator nodes are the purely cosmetic part -- grouping/nesting containers around that sequence.

color.description: Hex separator color (e.g. "#ff0000"). Omitted when the separator has no color.

children.description: Separators nest -- children may themselves contain separator nodes.

id.description: Must resolve to a mods/<id>.json id, OR an executables/<id>.json entry's output.syntheticModId. Referential integrity, not schema-expressible -- validate as a separate pass.
